sharedMapEvidence: DIALECT UNKNOWN, and the retail name is actively misleading. The Cabin Depot's 'iTracer AN G3' is model IT6415NC G3 — a member of EPEVER's IT-NC G3 series (50–100 A). That is NOT the 'iTracer' named on the cover of protocol v2.5; that document's iTracer is the older iTracer ND series (iTracer-ND manual, https://www.epever.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/iTracer-ND-SMS-EL-V3.0.pdf). Landing IT6415NC
gotchas: The retailer's name and the manufacturer's part number disagree about which product line this is. Buy on the part number IT6415NC G3, and research the protocol against IT-NC G3, not against 'iTracer'.

Three separate ports that all say 'communication': isolated RS-485 (monitoring), CAN-PARA In/Out (parallelling up to six identical controllers), and a BMS port (lithium pack). They are not interchangeable and only the RS-485 is plausibly a gateway target.
The retailer notes the RS-485 and CAN modules are sold separately.
